backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing user profiles, height predictions, and growth logs with access control and CRUD operations.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing UI color‑token updates and text‑color audit requirements with associated files and metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of major frontend components, hooks, utilities, and styles.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind base stylesheet defining OKLCH color tokens, theming variables, and background/foreground defaults for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading the main TypeScript bundle.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Top-level React component handling authentication state, theme setup, and layout composition with optional profile‑setup dialog.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Hero banner with title, description, and themed image highlighting the app’s height‑prediction and growth‑tracking features.
App layout wrapper providing header, footer, and central content structure.
frontend/src/components/layout/Footer.ts: Footer displaying copyright and a caffeine.ai attribution link with tracking parameters.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Header with branding and Internet Identity login/logout controls, including toast feedback and query cache reset on logout.
frontend/src/components/MainContent.tsx: Tabbed main interface switching between profile, prediction, growth log, and tips panels with icon‑based navigation.
frontend/src/features/growth/GrowthChart: Renders a line chart of height logs using Recharts, converting timestamps to dates and plotting height over time.
frontend/src/features/growth/GrowthLogPa: Manages viewing, adding, editing, and deleting height measurements, and displays logs alongside a growth chart.
frontend/src/features/prediction/compone: Displays a loading card with a spinner and text while predictions are being calculated.
frontend/src/features/prediction/predict: Implements multiple height‑prediction formulas and returns individual results plus an averaged prediction.
frontend/src/features/prediction/Predict: Presents two prediction method options with descriptions and navigation callbacks.
Controls navigation between landing, standard prediction, and puberty estimator views.
Displays height prediction results, including average height and individual formula outputs.
frontend/src/features/prediction/puberty: Provides functions to estimate bone age from puberty stage and predict height based on bone age, current height, and parental heights.
Defines puberty questionnaire data and computes a puberty stage result from user answers.
frontend/src/features/prediction/Puberty: Shows puberty stage assessment results, estimated bone age, and height prediction with navigation options.
Runs a multi-step puberty questionnaire, tracks answers, and displays results when complete.
frontend/src/features/prediction/Standar: UI component that runs height prediction calculations using profile data, shows loading state, and saves results if authenticated.
frontend/src/features/profile/ProfileInp: Profile form component allowing users to input and save age, gender, and height data with unit handling and validation.
frontend/src/features/profile/ProfileSet: Initial setup dialog that collects basic profile fields and saves a minimal default profile.
frontend/src/features/recommendations/re: Provides age‑group‑based diet and exercise recommendation data and a function to retrieve the appropriate set.
frontend/src/features/recommendations/Re: Displays diet and exercise recommendations based on user profile age and gender, with disclaimers and conditional alerts.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity, reinitializing and invalidating queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity login handling, identity persistence, and a React provider exposing authentication state and actions.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profile, growth logs, and predictions through the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useSafeActor.ts: Creates a backend actor with safe access‑control initialization and triggers query invalidation on actor changes.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets up Tailwind and defines light/dark theme CSS variables for a green‑themed UI.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app root with QueryClient and InternetIdentity providers.
frontend/src/utils/age.ts: Utility functions for calculating age from birthdates or year values.
frontend/src/utils/heightInput.ts: Provides functions to sanitize, validate, format, and parse height inputs differently for cm and inches.
frontend/src/utils/units.ts: Contains basic unit conversion helpers for cm, inches, and feet/inches formatting.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Implements utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters and sessionStorage-backed params.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme colors, radii, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state describing requirements, issues, and requested features related to fixing global text color theming.
